taste.name: One green, no second brand hue
taste.trigger: When the brand needed emphasis in headlines, CTAs, icons and section bands
taste.decision: Chose a single green family (#008F3C primary, #003D1A/#004015 dark, #EFF7F2 soft) over pairing green with a secondary brand colour such as gold or navy
taste.reason: Because a brokerage is judged on steadiness: one recurring colour makes every green element read as 'Insight' and keeps attention on the numbers and the call to action
evidence: --primary 145 100% 28% = #008F3C on 'Get in Touch' (44px) and headline words
neutrals are 0% saturation (#1A1A1A, #737373, #E6E6E6) so no other hue competes

taste.name: Live market data gets its own dark terminal register
taste.trigger: When putting live PSX prices on a marketing page that is otherwise white
taste.decision: Chose a fixed, near-black ticker (#111315 bar, #1A1D20 chips) with neon up/down colours (#27D996 / #FF5867) over styling prices in the page's own white-and-green palette
taste.reason: Because traders recognise the dark-strip-with-coloured-deltas look as 'market data', so they know these numbers are live and from the exchange, not marketing copy
evidence: change shown as tinted pill rgba(39,217,150,0.1) / rgba(255,88,103,0.1)
body padding-bottom 74px reserves space for it

taste.name: Full-bleed colour bands instead of dividers
taste.trigger: When separating ten-plus marketing sections on one long (5,842px) page
taste.decision: Chose alternating full-width bands (white, deep green, white, #141414, white, #004015 footer) with 80px section padding over hairline dividers or a uniform white page
taste.reason: Because on a long scroll a colour change is the strongest 'new chapter' signal, and each dark band lets one product (trading portal, awards) be the focus
evidence: 80px and 64px rank among the most frequent spacing values

taste.name: Off-the-shelf component system, not bespoke type
taste.trigger: When choosing type, radii and shadows for a React + Tailwind build
taste.decision: Chose shadcn/Tailwind defaults (Inter only, --radius 0.75rem, Tailwind sm/md/lg shadows, 150-200ms ease) over a custom type pairing and hand-tuned elevation
taste.reason: Because the vendor optimised for build speed and consistency across pages; the cost is that numbers, tables and headings have no distinct voice, and that is the gap a data product can fill
evidence: radii 7px / 12px / 16px / 9999px with no clear parent-child logic
